description: This INRAE dataset measures the raw wastewater discharged by single-family homes in France, and is described in a Data in Brief article. In one campaign, water heights at the pumping station of three homes were recorded every minute for between one year and eight months and two years and two months, giving discharged volumes over time. In a second campaign, more than 300 samples of 24 hours of raw wastewater from 15 homes, over seven consecutive days including weekends, were analysed for volume and for COD, BOD5, suspended solids, Kjeldahl nitrogen, ammonium and total phosphorus. Coverage is 15 homes in several French departments. The data are a free download from the national research data repository (formerly Data INRAE) under the Etalab 2.0 open licence, as CSV and tabular files; the article validation includes an R script. Caveats: homes were chosen mainly for technical feasibility of monitoring on private property, so the sample is small. Simulation uses: design flows and pollutant loads for onsite and small wastewater treatment systems and sewer inflow profiles. Related records: DAIAD Alicante smart meter series (data-daiad-alicante-smart-water-meter-time-series) and treatment unit process costs (data-wastewater-treatment-unit-processes-removal-costs).
